name: @mockups/sales-admin
description: Desktop Sales Admin demo for salesperson planning, task scheduling, attendance and reporting.

scripts.dev: bun prepare-index.ts && cd app && bun run ng serve --port 5181
scripts.build: bun prepare-index.ts && cd app && bun run ng build --configuration production
scripts.typecheck: cd app && bun run tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && bun run tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e: bun prepare-index.ts && cd app && bun run e2e
